method: Calendar-pace projection: observed year-to-date count × days in year ÷ days elapsed. Shares hold the observed category mix constant.
scenario_method: Apply each of the five historical same-calendar-date-to-full-year multipliers separately to the current numerator and denominator. The displayed min–max includes the calendar-pace projection and valid historical scenarios.
range_interpretation: Sensitivity to these timing assumptions only. Not a probability interval; outcomes may lie outside it.
assumptions: The current dated-record pace and category mix continue through year-end.
The snapshot date is used as the cutoff; recent reporting completeness is unknown.
No correction for reporting delays, historical backfill, changing coverage, seasonality, or classification changes is included in the central projection.
Historical scenarios use retrospectively classified records in this snapshot, not genuine earlier exports. They do not measure reporting lag.
confidence: Low; conditional illustration, not a validated forecast.
